title: Two ways to finish a bean skillet
titleZh: 豆子鍋的兩種完成方式
passage:
The Weeknight Spoon | Reader recipe digest

A bean skillet is a good way to feed people who eat at different times. Cook the onions until soft, then stir in the drained beans and a cup of water. Simmer until the beans are hot. This is the shared base; do not add the lemon or toast yet. To make just one bowl, scoop out only what you need and finish it as described below. The quantities for the toppings are per bowl, not for the whole pan.

For a bowl you will serve right away, stir in a spoonful of lemon juice just before serving and scatter crushed toast over the top. For a bowl you are packing, leave the lemon in a separate screw-top cup and put the toast in a dry paper bag. Add both just before eating. Toast will stay crisp in a dry bag, but it will soften if packed on top of the moist beans.

If you have no bread, toasted sunflower seeds can replace the crushed toast. The seeds go in at the same point in either version. They replace the crunchy part, not the lemon.
passageZh:
《平日晚餐一匙》｜讀者食譜摘要

家人用餐時間不同時，可以煮一鍋豆子。先把洋蔥煮軟，再拌入瀝乾的豆子和一杯水。用小火煮至豆子熱透。這是共用底料，先不要加檸檬汁或吐司。只做一碗時，舀出需要的份量，再按下方方式完成。配料的用量是以每碗為單位，不是整鍋。

如果這碗要立刻上桌，請在上桌前拌入一匙檸檬汁，再撒上捏碎的吐司。如果要外帶，將檸檬汁另外裝進旋蓋小杯，吐司則放進乾燥的紙袋。食用前再加進去。吐司放在乾燥紙袋中能保持酥脆，但如果直接放在濕潤的豆子上一起打包，吐司就會變軟。

沒有麵包時，可以用烘烤過的葵花籽取代吐司碎。兩種做法中，葵花籽各在原先加吐司的那個步驟加入。葵花籽取代的是酥脆的配料，不是檸檬汁。
